content: The tongue never slips when the heart is quiet.
author: Chinese Proverbs
explanation: Verbal blunders, cruel jibes, and boastful boasts rarely originate in the vocal cords; they bubble up from an agitated, insecure, or vengeful heart. When the internal lake of awareness is calm and undisturbed, speech is naturally economical, gentle, and true.
practicalInsight: Before attending an important meeting or dinner, sit in stillness until your internal chatter subsides into quiet peace.
reflectionPrompt: What emotional unrest in your heart is currently driving reckless speech or restless chatter?
